# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is stout and fat.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie is malicious, disagreeable, and sharp-tongued, often making spiteful comments to others. She is lacking in imagination and can be a cheat. She displays a triumphant, taunting, and scornfully envious demeanor toward her peers.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)_

## History

Josie attended Avonlea school, where she was the last member of the Pye family to be enrolled. During her school days, she showed a natural talent for walking board fences and challenged Anne Shirley to walk a ridgepole. She also participated in school concerts and events, though she sulked when she did not get her preferred role as the fairy queen. She caused a three-month quarrel with Julia Bell by making a disparaging comment about Julia's reciting bow. At the exhibition, Josie won first prize for her knitted lace. She later studied for the entrance examinations and attended Queen's Academy, taking the Second Class course for education's sake rather than out of a need to earn a living.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)_
